findingDetails.title: The 005 opening says the references add two design checks and one test while the section carries six rows, and the three it omits include a confirmed plan defect
findingDetails.scopeProof: The sentence is research.md:175; the six rows are :181-198; the contradiction is B/005-memory/spec.md:96 against :162 and B/contracts/prompt-sections.md:237, all three read directly.
findingDetails.case: A builder reads the 005 opening, notes two design checks and one test, and never opens pitfall 2, so the memory false wording stays as line 96 has it and a bot with memory false still reads the shared file.
findingDetails.claim: The opening is a closed enumeration of three items while the section holds six rows, and the omitted pitfall 2 is a confirmed plan defect.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read the whole opening paragraph to see whether the count is scoped to the two checks it then explains; the sentence says what the references add, with no scoping clause.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The opening summarises the two checks the paragraph explains and leaves the pitfall table to speak for itself, which is how the other phase openings read.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A scoping clause in the sentence, such as the two checks the paragraph then explains, or a count that matches the section.

results.summary: Every row checked in 005 to 008 resolves to a line that says what the row claims; the one defect is a summary sentence that undercounts its own section
